'''Erbus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual associated with the [[Orange Lady Tavern]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[Saahir Ru'luv]] knew him, and directed [[Trep Winterrs]] to him for food when he and [[Thaddeus Ross]] were berthed in [[Dock 52]].<ref name="LAD" />
